motivation: Historical v0.77 accepted-source traces show very large dimensionless chi transfer amplitudes in the certified k window. Before interpreting the NL0C deep-MOND Y^(3/2) operator at the actual primordial cosmological amplitude, test whether the corresponding physical spatial-gradient RMS is actually in the deep-MOND, transition, or high-gradient regime. This audit is explicitly result-informed by the preserved v0.77 trace and does not treat that observation as blinded.

numerical_configuration.time_sampling: unchanged CLASS accepted perturbations_sources native sampling; no off-native time interpolation in the primary audit

band_integral.formula: x_rms^2 = sum_i w_i [c^2 k_i/(a a0)]^2 P_R(k_i) chi_i(z)^2
band_integral.chi_normalization: CLASS scalar perturbations are transfer functions normalized to primordial curvature R=1; multiply by primordial dimensionless curvature power P_R for RMS
band_integral.integration: trapezoidal rule in ln k over exactly [0.03,0.20] h/Mpc
band_integral.physical_gradient: X_hat_i^(1)=a^-1 partial_i chi, hence the explicit 1/a factor

regime_thresholds.note: 0.1 and 10 are fixed decade safety bands around the physical transition x=1, not fitted thresholds

classification_rule.deep: all primary native times have x_rms <= 0.1 -> NL1C0_LINEAR_STATE_DEEP_MOND_REGIME
classification_rule.high: all primary native times have x_rms >= 10 -> NL1C0_LINEAR_STATE_HIGH_GRADIENT_REGIME

continuation_rule.if_deep: the NL0C deep-MOND directional operator is amplitude-consistent for the tested linear state; proceed to directional NL1C implementation
continuation_rule.if_high: do not promote the deep-MOND NL0C operator to a physical-amplitude nonlinear prediction; preregister the full published J(Y) interpolation family as co-primary before physical nonlinear evolution
continuation_rule.if_mixed: do not use a single asymptotic branch globally; preregister a full-interpolation or regime-separated continuation before physical nonlinear evolution

forbidden_claims: do not alter historical PASS or FAIL classifications
do not infer nonlinear saturation from this linear-amplitude regime audit
do not choose a preferred beta0 or interpolation function after seeing the result
do not remove the physical 1/a gradient factor
do not use pk_lin off-native interpolation for the primary audit
